key_facts: Updated July 18 post-qualifying (T+1d FINAL DAY to July 19 Belgian GP; shifted George Russell 0.71->0.78, Lewis Hamilton 0.29->0.22, exhaustive sum=1.00). Standings entering Spa: Antonelli 179 (5 wins, locked P1), Russell 154 (+7 pts over HAM & wins all tiebreakers incl HAM P1/RUS P2), Hamilton 147 (must strictly outscore RUS by >=8 pts: HAM P1 w/ RUS P3+, HAM P2 w/ RUS P5+, HAM P3 w/ RUS P7+, HAM P4 w/ RUS P8+, HAM P5 w/ RUS P9+, HAM P6 w/ RUS P11+/DNF; impossible if HAM<=P7). (3) Sunday Spa weather eased to mostly dry (PlanetF1 July 18: 10% in-race rain, 21C; Total Motorsport: 20%). (4) Key counterweight capping Russell at 0.78: Russell, Wolff & Shovlin confirmed an unresolved 'serious issue' costing Russell 0.2-0.6s on straights (0.4s in Q3, early battery deployment drop-off into final chicane; Wolff noted Antonelli has a brand-new PU). This creates race overtaking vulnerability on Kemmel Straight/Blanchimont plus elevated mechanical DNF/parc-ferme tail risk (~11% DNF -> ~9.8% HAM P2 via RUS DNF alone). Both Gaussian MC race-pace/weather mixture (0.775, ~0.768 w/ parc-ferme tail) and Plackett-Luce post-qualy/BettingPlanet blend (0.780) converge cleanly on 0.78/0.22.
